description: Returns daily price history for the stock around the date of a specific insider trading alert, useful for backtesting whether the signal preceded a price move. Requires an alert id from edgaralert_search_alerts or edgaralert_get_latest_alerts. Requires EDGAR Alert PRO plan or higher.

alertId.description: The numeric id of the alert (from a search or latest-alerts result).

daysAfter.description: Days of price history after the alert date.

daysBefore.description: Days of price history before the alert date.

scope.description: "watchlist" restricts to the user's default ticker list, "universe" (default) does not.

name: edgaralert_get_alert_price_window
title: Get stock price performance around an alert
